hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */godot/*.gd) g="${f%%/godot/*}/godot"; [ -f "$g/project.godot" ] && /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot --path "$g" --headless --import >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
